scripts._comment_test: Glob rather than a bare directory: `node --test backend/test` fails to resolve on Windows, while the quoted pattern is globbed by Node itself and works everywhere. Needs no dependencies — node:test is built in.
scripts._comment_mock: Runs a whole draft against the real database and puts everything back. Refuses to touch a draft that is live or paused. Args: team count, rounds.
scripts._comment_build: Installs both halves itself rather than trusting postinstall. A host that runs `npm install --ignore-scripts` (several do) skips postinstall silently, and the failure surfaces much later as `vite: not found` at build time, or `Cannot find module 'express'` at boot. Repeating an install that already happened costs a few seconds; not doing one costs the deploy.
scripts._comment_include_dev: --include=dev is load-bearing on the frontend install. vite, tailwind, postcss and autoprefixer are devDependencies, and npm SKIPS devDependencies whenever NODE_ENV=production — which it is on the live host, because the server needs it for secure cookies. Without this flag the deploy installs the frontend's runtime deps, then dies on `vite: not found` with a NODE_ENV nobody thinks to blame.
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
